svg.title: Responsive layouts
svg.desc: Five layout archetypes at three breakpoints. Media blocks are shown solid; text blocks as bars. The hierarchy never changes between sizes; only the number of things side by side does. · Wake, A Glance-inspired design system. Original vector artwork; not a Glance asset.

solid; text blocks as bars. The hierarchy never changes between sizes;
